gates.default: uv run pytest -m "not live" && uv run ruff check src/ tests/ && uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/ && uv run mypy src/

interactive_only: live smoke against the real Splitwise account (personal API key)
alejlatorre-mcps registration + hot deploy with live sessions
ax42 systemd unit + Tailscale Funnel path (sudo, public exposure)
Grok Bot connector (UI) + end-to-end check through the public URL

reversibility_triggers.decision: publish to PyPI as `amazing-splitwise-mcp` (ADR-0001; `splitwise-mcp` and `splitwise-mcp-server` are taken)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: the user registers the pending trusted publisher under a different free name (e.g. `trustai-splitwise-mcp`)
reversibility_triggers.fallback: rename dist + console scripts in lockstep on main before the first release; import package `splitwise_mcp` and tool prefix `splitwise_` never change

reversibility_triggers.decision: stdio stays the default transport; streamable-http is a second console script (`amazing-splitwise-mcp-http`) that refuses to start without SPLITWISE_MCP_BEARER and binds 127.0.0.1 by default (ships in v0.1 because Grok Bot only takes a public URL)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a client needs OAuth (discovery + token issuance) instead of a static bearer, or Grok rejects a custom Authorization header
reversibility_triggers.fallback: keep the ASGI bearer middleware and add the SDK's TokenVerifier/AuthSettings path behind a second env flag; stdio and the static bearer remain

reversibility_triggers.decision: host the public endpoint on ax42 as a systemd user unit behind the existing Tailscale Funnel (second path /splitwise on the 443 that already serves Obsidian)
reversibility_triggers.trigger: ax42 is unreachable for a day, Funnel is disabled for the tailnet, or a second Grok-facing MCP needs its own hostname
reversibility_triggers.fallback: run the same Dockerfile as a Railway service with SPLITWISE_MCP_BEARER as a Railway variable and point Grok at the Railway domain

reversibility_triggers.decision: name resolution (friend / group / category) uses stdlib difflib, no rapidfuzz dependency
reversibility_triggers.trigger: a live-smoke query with a real name mis-resolves (wrong top match) or a resolve tool exceeds 200 ms on the real friend list
reversibility_triggers.fallback: add `rapidfuzz` as a runtime dependency and swap the scorer in tools/lookup.py only

reversibility_triggers.decision: raw httpx client + in-repo form flattening (users__{i}__{prop}), no `splitwise` SDK dependency
reversibility_triggers.trigger: an endpoint needs a serialization quirk that costs more than a day to reproduce
reversibility_triggers.fallback: vendor the exact helper from the reference client (MIT) with attribution; still no SDK dependency

reversibility_triggers.decision: writes are gated by SPLITWISE_ALLOW_WRITES (default off); the ax42 unit turns it on deliberately for Grok
reversibility_triggers.trigger: Grok must create expenses from chat and the operator wants no second switch
reversibility_triggers.fallback: none needed — set SPLITWISE_ALLOW_WRITES=1 in the unit's env file; the switch stays in the package
